title: Chapter 436 - 436 Mission Completed; You Can Stand Up Soon!
content:
Chapter 436 - 436 Mission Completed; You Can Stand Up Soon!

Chapter 436 - 436 Mission Completed; You Can Stand Up Soon!

436 Mission Completed; You Can Stand Up Soon!

“There’s no need to consider!”

“I agree!”

“I agree too!”

All the workers shouted. The entire workshop was noisy. No one chose to leave.

After all, their salary would double!

What if they went back and thought about it for a night, and in the end, they lost their chance?

They would definitely regret it for the rest of their lives!

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could not help but frown.

He did not like this kind of noisy scene.

Especially since he still had a mission to complete. Hu Tian and Hu Shaodong were still waiting for him at home.

Yao Hanqing, who was standing at the side, seemed to have noticed Lin Fan’s unhappiness. He hurriedly said, “Those who want to stay, go to the square and register with Manager Qu!

“The quota is limited! If you’re late, we’ll take it as an application to resign! After registration, you can come back to work officially tomorrow!”

He did not think that Lin Fan was joking when he said that he would double their salary and pay N+2 compensation.

One had to know…

Lin Fan had just spent two billion to buy Qinqin Toy Factory.

After Yao Hanqing finished speaking, the employees no longer dared to make any noise and rushed to the square.

Soon, the entire workshop became empty and silent.

Lin Fan nodded in satisfaction. “Not bad.”

Even though it was just two simple words, in Yao Hanqing’s ears, they sounded like beautiful music.

“Thank you for your praise!” Yao Hanqing said happily.

Lin Fan said, “Now, teach me how to make toys.”

“Alright,” Yao Hanqing said.

Yao Hanqing held a small motor and plastic cover while saying, “These are the parts of the toy car. You just need to assemble them.”

As he spoke, he assembled about a dozen components together.

Soon, a mini car appeared in front of him. After installing the battery, it could run at a relatively fast speed.

A minute after Yao Hanqing had finished assembling it, Lin Fan finished assembling another one.

This was normal…

After all, making this toy was very simple.

Lin Fan had a photographic memory, so how could he not finish assembling it quickly?

Yao Hanqing looked at Lin Fan’s quick and perfect installation of the toy and could not help but praise, “Mr. Lin, your assembly speed is so fast!”

Lin Fan ignored him and focused on the mission system.

[Mission: Buy one million toys (1 million/1 million) and make 100 different toys (1/100). Reward: Perfect artificial limbs, as well as the machinery, tools, and principles for making artificial limbs.]

Lin Fan said, “Make the next toy.”

“Alright,” Yao Hanqing said.

Then, they assembled Thomas & Friends, different Ultramans, Iron Man in various positions, many toy guns, excavators, slides, and so on.

It had to be said that there were indeed many types of toys in Qinqin Toy Factory.

Yao Hanqing was also proficient in making all kinds of toys.

In the blink of an eye, three hours had passed.

Yao Hanqing picked up another set of components and was about to assemble them.

At this moment, Lin Fan, who had been silent all this while, suddenly said, “That’s enough.”

That was because a clear notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Mission Completed: Buy one million toys (1 million/1 million) and make 100 different toys (100/100). You’ve obtained perfect artificial limbs, as well as the machinery, tools, and principles for making artificial limbs.]

Mission accomplished!

At the same time, Lin Fan’s mind was filled with a lot of knowledge about artificial limbs.

After a while, a smile appeared on his face.

According to the prosthetic knowledge provided by the system, he knew that Hu Shaodong could stand up!

When Yao Hanqing heard Lin Fan’s words, he heaved a sigh of relief.

After making toys for three hours, he was a little tired.

Lin Fan said, “Alright, that’s all for today. I’ll come back tomorrow.”

“Alright,” Yao Hanqing replied.

Then, Lin Fan did not stay any longer and drove the Cullinan into the distance.

…

In the courtyard of the Hu family…

After Hu Shaodong took three bottles of Medical Water, his overall condition was no different from before, except that his legs still had not grown back.

There was no difference?

That was not true!

In fact, there was still a difference.

Hu Shaodong had been suffering from ringing in his ears, nasal obstruction, sore throat, and other ailments for many years, but all of them had disappeared without a trace.

Hu Shaodong saw that the Hu family members still had some sadness on their faces, so he forced a smile and said, “Dad, Mom, Uncle, Aunt, you don’t have to be unhappy. I think it’s good this way. In the future, I don’t have to train or run around. I can always be by your side.”

Everyone could tell that he was trying to comfort them.

They suppressed their urge to cry and nodded.

“Lin Fan had that magic potion. Since he said that he can make Shaodong stand up again, I believe it’ll happen!”

When Hu Shaodong heard this, his heartbeat quickened.

Soon, however, he shook his head helplessly.

A method?

What method?

If Lin Fan did have a method, he would have said it out loud just now.

It was impossible to regrow legs out of thin air!

“Tiantian, didn’t you just call Lin Fan? Did he say what he was doing?”

Hu Tian hesitated for a moment and said, “He… He said he went to the toy factory.”

Her aunt clearly wanted Hu Tian to say something to comfort Hu Shaodong.

However, if she really said words of reassurance, what would Lin Fan do when he came?

At this time, the greater the hope, the greater the disappointment!

It would also make things difficult for Lin Fan.

Hu Tian did not want Lin Fan to be in a difficult position.

In fact…

When Lin Fan left the Hu Family, he said that he wanted to go to the toy factory.

However, Hu Shaodong and the Hu family still had a glimmer of hope in their hearts.

What if…

What if they had heard wrongly?

What if Lin Fan went to find a godly potion that could help Hu Shaodong stand up?

At this moment, after hearing Hu Tian’s words, the last bit of hope in everyone’s hearts turned into a bubble.

“What is he doing in the toy factory now?” someone asked in a low voice.

Hu Shaodong smiled and said, “Maybe Lin Fan went to the toy factory because he wants to customize toys for my future nephews and nieces… Not bad! Tiantian, it’s time for you to have a child.”

When Hu Tian heard this, her pretty face could not help but blush.

When the Hu family heard this, their mood improved slightly, and a hint of anticipation appeared on their faces.

At this moment, the sound of brisk footsteps could be heard from outside.

It was Lin Fan, who had been out for a few hours!

At this moment, Lin Fan walked in with a big box and shouted, “Second Brother Hu, you’ll be able to stand up soon!”

As soon as he said this, Hu Nanshan, Hu Tian, Hu Kaixuan, and Hu Shaodong, who was lying on the bed, turned around.

All eyes were on Lin Fan!

Hu Shaodong could stand up soon!

Everyone’s hearts began to beat faster and faster!
